_doc: fc-system2-002 (filesystem, read_file with path reasoning): the user asks the model to read the system timezone setting. The model has to know that /etc/timezone is the canonical file (Debian-style) and call read_file with that path. The reasoning required: Linux filesystem layout knowledge. The 4-bit model can produce both `` and the read_file call in 512 tokens when only 1 tool is exposed.
prompt: I need to read the system timezone setting. Find the right file under /etc/ and read it with the read_file tool. Tell me the timezone name.
system: Before answering, write your reasoning inside a <thought>...</thought> block. Then call the tool using the <tool_call> format.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read, e.g. /etc/hostname
